tagline: Pure white page with charcoal text and one Klein-blue accent used under 10 percent: short rules, a thin vertical bar and ghosted section numbers, no radius.

palette.description: white, charcoal and a single international Klein blue

typography.style: system grotesque stack (SF Pro Display, Helvetica Neue, Arial) in three size tiers

best_for: Talks where whitespace carries the weight: design proposals, product reveals, short keynotes. Blue marks only the single thing that matters.
avoid_for: Dense data decks or festive audiences; over 40 percent of every slide is intentionally empty.
name: Klein Minimalism
